title: drevalpy/curate pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input: one row per screen

id.errorMessage: Screen id must be provided and may only contain letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'

wells.errorMessage: Well table must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.csv', '.parquet' or '.pq'

normalize.errorMessage: normalize must be true or false

metadata.errorMessage: metadata must be a ';'-separated list of column names without spaces
